title: Epoch-aware wildcard version matching disagrees with zero padding
body: Curated behavior-only historical report: Specifier('==2!1.0.0.0.*').contains('2!1.0.0') returns False although the epoch matches and the release components differ only by trailing zeros. Investigate and repair prefix matching while preserving unequal-epoch rejection, ordinary prefix matching and compatible-release behavior. Source imports are available through PYTHONPATH=src.
